scope: Five presidents,19 downloaded official transcripts; candidates only

chunks.meaning: 缓和紧张局面；给争论降温
chunks.note: 这里的 temperature 是冲突强度，不是实际温度；说话时还需把前面的口语长句整理清楚。
chunks.quote: bring down the temperature.
chunks.transfer: Let's bring down the temperature and focus on what we can fix.

chunks.meaning: 消除疑虑、结束争论，使某个问题不再反复被提起
chunks.note: 不等于每一种 solve；常配 doubts、fears、rumors、questions。原句用 lay to rest the question，宾语较长所以后置。
chunks.quote: I also hope we can lay to rest the question about the integrity of the American electoral system.
chunks.transfer: The new evidence should lay those doubts to rest.

chunks.meaning: 让每一天／每一刻都有价值；充分利用时间
chunks.note: count 在此是有价值、产生作用，不是计数；不是 every 后可随意装任何名词的万能结构。
chunks.quote: Let's make every day count.
chunks.transfer: We only have a week left, so let's make every day count.

chunks.meaning: 保持信心，别因受挫而放弃相信
chunks.note: faith 在此可指信心，不必指宗教；日常更直白可说 don't lose hope。
chunks.quote: And above all, we need to keep the faith.
chunks.transfer: It's been a difficult year, but I'm trying to keep the faith.

chunks.meaning: 不论输赢；输赢都一样适用
chunks.note: 可放句首或句尾补充条件；不是句子表达 only when 的同义替换，而是把相反条件都纳入。
chunks.quote: And it can be trusted, win or lose.
chunks.transfer: Win or lose, I'm glad we gave it a try.

chunks.meaning: 达到理想、承诺或期待的标准
chunks.note: 不是住在某地；常说 live up to expectations 或 live up to a promise。
chunks.quote: We've never fully lived up to that idea, but we've never walked away from it.
chunks.transfer: The product didn't live up to my expectations.

chunks.meaning: 这么做会自担危险／后果；带警告
chunks.note: 比 at one's own risk 更带危险感，不宜用于每件小事。
chunks.quote: We lose these institutions of our government at our own peril.
chunks.transfer: We ignore these warning signs at our own peril.

chunks.meaning: 如果……我会很意外；间接表示自己觉得那不太可能
chunks.note: if 从句的肯定／否定决定预测方向；原句的 anything different 表示预计别人也听到相同担忧。
chunks.quote: I'd be surprised if you heard anything different than the concern about: Are we okay?
chunks.transfer: I'd be surprised if we finished this by Friday.

chunks.meaning: 尽管它有种种缺点，仍然……
chunks.note: for all 在此表达让步，不是为了全部；换对象时可用 for all his/her/their faults。原文 pass 后附官方 path 更正，照录。
chunks.quote: For all its faults though, American democracy remains the best pass [path; White House correction] forward to prosperity, possibilities, progress, fair play, equality.
chunks.transfer: For all its faults, this is still the tool I use most.

chunks.note: 用来从玩笑切回认真话题；没有玩笑铺垫时不必硬用。原句后续 more ... as ... 是口语中的不整齐比较结构，不作为模板；这里只收话题切换词块。
chunks.quote: But, all kidding aside, I've never been more optimistic about America's chances in domestic and foreign policy as I am today.
chunks.transfer: All kidding aside, I really appreciate your help.

chunks.chunk: The real credit doesn't go to sb./sth.
chunks.meaning: 真正的功劳不属于 X（而应归给别人）
chunks.note: credit 是功劳、认可，不是贷款额度；原段下一句把认可给了听众。
chunks.quote: But the real credit doesn't go to me and my administration for the progress—for this progress.
chunks.transfer: The real credit doesn't go to me; it goes to the people who tested it.

chunks.meaning: X 从来不是理所当然或自动有保证的
chunks.note: a given 作名词指可当成既定事实的东西；不能理解为过去分词被给予。
chunks.quote: greatness is never a given.
chunks.transfer: Trust is never a given; you have to earn it.

chunks.meaning: 接受更低的标准或次一等的结果；将就
chunks.note: settle for 指接受不那么理想的选项；less 的比较标准由语境给出。
chunks.quote: Our journey has never been one of shortcuts or settling for less.
chunks.transfer: We don't have to settle for less just because we're in a hurry.

chunks.chunk: The question is not whether [A], but whether [B]
chunks.meaning: 真正要问的不是 A，而是 B；重新界定讨论焦点
chunks.note: whether A/B 可各接一个完整判断；不只是替换 but，而是在转移判定标准。
chunks.quote: The question we ask today is not whether our Government is too big or too small, but whether it works;
chunks.transfer: The question is not whether we can build it, but whether anyone needs it.

chunks.meaning: 不是出于 X，而是因为 Y；澄清动机
chunks.note: out of 在此引出动机，X 常为情绪或态度名词，Y 为从句；不要照抄原政治主张。
chunks.quote: not out of charity, but because it is the surest route to our common good.
chunks.transfer: I asked not out of curiosity, but because I needed to make a decision.

chunks.meaning: 帮助某人撑过困难时期
chunks.note: 不是看穿某人；与 see through an excuse（识破借口）区分。原句包含 which 回指，不能把截取片段当完整句。
chunks.quote: which sees us through our darkest hours.
chunks.transfer: Her support saw me through a very difficult year.

chunks.note: 带明确负面评价；评价同事时可能显得尖锐。
chunks.quote: We will no longer accept politicians who are all talk and no action, constantly complaining, but never doing anything about it.
chunks.transfer: He makes big promises, but he's all talk and no action.

chunks.meaning: 把任务完成；重点在结果
chunks.note: job 可以是具体任务，不一定是职业岗位；不自动表示完成得好。
chunks.quote: We will face challenges, we will confront hardships, but we will get the job done.
chunks.transfer: It isn't perfect, but it gets the job done.

chunks.meaning: 让某人失望；辜负其期待
chunks.note: 此处不是物理上放下人；ever 强化原句的承诺。
chunks.quote: I will fight for you with every breath in my body, and I will never, ever let you down.
chunks.transfer: I know you were counting on me, and I'm sorry I let you down.

chunks.meaning: 没有容纳 X 的余地；某种态度或行为不应存在
chunks.note: 可字面指空间，也可抽象表达不容许；no room for error 表示不允许出错。
chunks.quote: When you open your heart to patriotism, there is no room for prejudice.
chunks.transfer: There's no room for personal attacks in this discussion.

chunks.meaning: 因某种责任或经历而感到谦卑
chunks.note: 不是受羞辱；常用于承接重任。
chunks.quote: My fellow citizens, I stand here today humbled by the task before us, grateful for the trust you have bestowed, mindful of the sacrifices borne by our ancestors.

chunks.note: 后接名词，表示有意识地考虑。
chunks.quote: My fellow citizens, I stand here today humbled by the task before us, grateful for the trust you have bestowed, mindful of the sacrifices borne by our ancestors.

chunks.note: 保留具体感谢理由的表达动作；不据简单判定已掌握。
chunks.quote: I thank President Bush for his service to our Nation, as well as the generosity and cooperation he has shown throughout this transition.

chunks.note: 非规律地发生，不等于 every day。
chunks.quote: Yet every so often, the oath is taken amidst gathering clouds and raging storms.

chunks.note: 原句无宾语；可另接 doing sth.。
chunks.quote: At these moments, America has carried on not simply because of the skill or vision of those in high office, but because we the people have remained faithful to the ideals of our forbearers and true to our founding documents.

chunks.meaning: 始终忠于某种理想或承诺
chunks.note: 适合价值或承诺，不是每种维持状态。
chunks.quote: At these moments, America has carried on not simply because of the skill or vision of those in high office, but because we the people have remained faithful to the ideals of our forbearers and true to our founding documents.

chunks.note: 常用来说明危机、活动或变化的阶段。
chunks.quote: That we are in the midst of crisis is now well understood.

chunks.meaning: 某人方面的；由某人表现出的
chunks.note: 不是某物的一部分。
chunks.quote: Our economy is badly weakened, a consequence of greed and irresponsibility on the part of some, but also our collective failure to make hard choices and prepare the Nation for a new age.

chunks.note: hard 指难以取舍，非难理解。
chunks.quote: Our economy is badly weakened, a consequence of greed and irresponsibility on the part of some, but also our collective failure to make hard choices and prepare the Nation for a new age.

chunks.note: 原句 less measurable but no less profound 对比可测性与影响。
chunks.quote: Less measurable but no less profound is a sapping of confidence across our land, a nagging fear that America's decline is inevitable, that the next generation must lower its sights.

chunks.chunk: a nagging fear that 从句
chunks.note: nagging 指反复缠绕，不是别人唠叨。
chunks.quote: Less measurable but no less profound is a sapping of confidence across our land, a nagging fear that America's decline is inevitable, that the next generation must lower its sights.

chunks.meaning: 降低自己的目标或期望
chunks.note: sights 不是此处的视力。
chunks.quote: Less measurable but no less profound is a sapping of confidence across our land, a nagging fear that America's decline is inevitable, that the next generation must lower its sights.

chunks.chunk: in a short span of time
chunks.note: span 指一段持续时间。
chunks.quote: They will not be met easily or in a short span of time.

chunks.note: over 表偏好，不是空间上方。
chunks.quote: On this day, we gather because we have chosen hope over fear, unity of purpose over conflict and discord.

chunks.note: far 强化 too long；暗示应当改变。
chunks.quote: On this day, we come to proclaim an end to the petty grievances and false promises, the recriminations and worn-out dogmas that for far too long have strangled our politics.

chunks.chunk: The time has come to do sth.
chunks.note: 语气比 it's time 更庄重。
chunks.quote: We remain a young nation, but in the words of Scripture, the time has come to set aside childish things.

chunks.note: 此处为放下幼稚行为，非预留资金义。
chunks.quote: We remain a young nation, but in the words of Scripture, the time has come to set aside childish things.

chunks.note: 可接工作、计划或传统；不指一般携带。
chunks.quote: The time has come to reaffirm our enduring spirit, to choose our better history, to carry forward that precious gift, that noble idea passed on from generation to generation: the God-given promise that all are equal, all are free, and all deserve a chance to pursue their full measure of happiness.

chunks.note: 原句被动 passed on；对象为理念。
chunks.quote: The time has come to reaffirm our enduring spirit, to choose our better history, to carry forward that precious gift, that noble idea passed on from generation to generation: the God-given promise that all are equal, all are free, and all deserve a chance to pursue their full measure of happiness.

chunks.note: 介词短语，可修饰旅行或行动。
chunks.quote: For us, they packed up their few worldly possessions and traveled across oceans in search of a new life.

chunks.note: 原句是打包随身物品；不混入停工义。
chunks.quote: For us, they packed up their few worldly possessions and traveled across oceans in search of a new life.

chunks.note: 强调整段经历里的重复。
chunks.quote: Time and again, these men and women struggled and sacrificed and worked ‘til their hands were raw so that we might live a better life.

chunks.note: 原句用 bigger than the sum 对比整体与部分；不将政治比喻整句固定化。
chunks.quote: They saw America as bigger than the sum of our individual ambitions, greater than all the differences of birth or wealth or faction.

chunks.note: 原句 standing pat；带保守不动的意味。
chunks.quote: But our time of standing pat, of protecting narrow interests and putting off unpleasant decisions, that time has surely passed.

chunks.note: 此处接 decisions；不是使人反感义。
chunks.quote: But our time of standing pat, of protecting narrow interests and putting off unpleasant decisions, that time has surely passed.

chunks.note: 此处为受挫后的恢复，亦有字面起身义。
chunks.quote: Starting today, we must pick ourselves up, dust ourselves off, and begin again the work of remaking America.

chunks.meaning: 受挫后整理心情重新开始
chunks.note: 与 pick oneself up 相接；此处为比喻。
chunks.quote: Starting today, we must pick ourselves up, dust ourselves off, and begin again the work of remaking America.

chunks.note: 此处是形势需要行动，不是呼叫某人。
chunks.quote: The state of the economy calls for action, bold and swift, and we will act not only to create new jobs but to lay a new foundation for growth.

chunks.note: foundation 可比喻后续发展条件。
chunks.quote: The state of the economy calls for action, bold and swift, and we will act not only to create new jobs but to lay a new foundation for growth.

chunks.note: demands 为要求，非 demand 动词。
chunks.quote: And we will transform our schools and colleges and universities to meet the demands of a new age.

chunks.chunk: There are some who 从句
chunks.note: 引入一种立场，原句 question 与 suggest 说明具体异议。
chunks.quote: Now, there are some who question the scale of our ambitions, who suggest that our system cannot tolerate too many big plans.

chunks.note: question 作动词；不等同询问尺寸。
chunks.quote: Now, there are some who question the scale of our ambitions, who suggest that our system cannot tolerate too many big plans.

chunks.chunk: What sb. fails to understand is that 从句
chunks.note: 指明对方遗漏，工作中可能显得强硬。
chunks.quote: What the cynics fail to understand is that the ground has shifted beneath them; that the stale political arguments that have consumed us for so long no longer apply.

chunks.meaning: 要求某人负责并接受问责
chunks.note: 原句被动 be held to account；不等于记账。
chunks.quote: And those of us who manage the public's dollars will be held to account to spend wisely, reform bad habits, and do our business in the light of day, because only then can we restore the vital trust between a people and their government.

chunks.meaning: 公开地；在公众可见之处
chunks.note: 原句指政府透明操作，也可字面指白天。
chunks.quote: And those of us who manage the public's dollars will be held to account to spend wisely, reform bad habits, and do our business in the light of day, because only then can we restore the vital trust between a people and their government.

chunks.meaning: 如果答案是肯定／否定的，就……
chunks.note: where 此处不是物理地点，而是适用情形。
chunks.quote: Where the answer is yes, we intend to move forward.

chunks.note: spin 带失控发展的意味。
chunks.quote: But this crisis has reminded us that without a watchful eye, the market can spin out of control.

chunks.meaning: 至于某事；转到另一个话题
chunks.note: 引出已相关的议题，不必机械接每段。
chunks.quote: As for our common defense, we reject as false the choice between our safety and our ideals.

chunks.meaning: 为了某事；看在某事份上
chunks.note: 原句 expedience's sake 为图方便，语境正式。
chunks.quote: Those ideals still light the world, and we will not give them up for expedience's sake.

chunks.meaning: 坚决对抗并压制某种威胁
chunks.note: 比 face 更有不退缩并迫使对方让步的意味。
chunks.quote: Recall that earlier generations faced down fascism and communism not just with missiles and tanks but with sturdy alliances and enduring convictions.

chunks.note: 否定可用于澄清资格并不授权任意行动。
chunks.quote: They understood that our power alone cannot protect us, nor does it entitle us to do as we please.

chunks.note: 原句 do as we please；可能带未经约束的负面意思。
chunks.quote: They understood that our power alone cannot protect us, nor does it entitle us to do as we please.

chunks.note: tirelessly 强调持续投入，日常承诺不宜夸大。
chunks.quote: With old friends and former foes, we will work tirelessly to lessen the nuclear threat and roll back the specter of a warming planet.

chunks.meaning: 逆转；削弱某种发展或影响
chunks.note: 与 rollback 软件含义相关但此处为遏制趋势。
chunks.quote: With old friends and former foes, we will work tirelessly to lessen the nuclear threat and roll back the specter of a warming planet.

chunks.note: 此处是相信；but 后动词原形。
chunks.quote: we cannot help but believe that the old hatreds shall someday pass;

chunks.chunk: usher in a new era of sth.
chunks.note: 庄重宣布改变，不声称日常高频。
chunks.quote: America must play its role in ushering in a new era of peace.

chunks.meaning: 把某个问题归咎于某人
chunks.note: 被指责的事在 blame 后，责任对象在 on 后。
chunks.quote: To those leaders around the globe who seek to sow conflict or blame their society's ills on the West, know that your people will judge you on what you can build, not what you destroy.

chunks.note: 此处 cling to power；不只字面抓住。
chunks.quote: To those who cling to power through corruption and deceit and the silencing of dissent, know that you are on the wrong side of history, but that we will extend a hand if you are willing to unclench your fist.

chunks.meaning: 伸出援手；表示愿意合作
chunks.note: 原句与 unclench your fist 构成修辞，只收可迁移部分。
chunks.quote: To those who cling to power through corruption and deceit and the silencing of dissent, know that you are on the wrong side of history, but that we will extend a hand if you are willing to unclench your fist.

chunks.meaning: 再也承受不起某种行为或状态
chunks.note: 此处不是金钱购买；表达继续如此代价太高。
chunks.quote: And to those nations like ours that enjoy relative plenty, we say we can no longer afford indifference to suffering outside our borders, nor can we consume the world's resources without regard to effect, for the world has changed, and we must change with it.

chunks.note: 后接后果、差异等名词。
chunks.quote: And to those nations like ours that enjoy relative plenty, we say we can no longer afford indifference to suffering outside our borders, nor can we consume the world's resources without regard to effect, for the world has changed, and we must change with it.

chunks.note: 不是理解一句话的含义。
chunks.quote: We honor them not only because they are guardians of our liberty, but because they embody the spirit of service, a willingness to find meaning in something greater than themselves.

chunks.note: take in 的收留义；与欺骗、领会义区分。
chunks.quote: It is the kindness to take in a stranger when the levees break, the selflessness of workers who would rather cut their hours than see a friend lose their job, which sees us through our darkest hours.

chunks.chunk: would rather do sth. than do sth.
chunks.meaning: 宁愿做前者也不愿后者
chunks.note: 原句宁减工时不愿朋友失业。
chunks.quote: It is the kindness to take in a stranger when the levees break, the selflessness of workers who would rather cut their hours than see a friend lose their job, which sees us through our darkest hours.

chunks.chunk: What is required of sb. is sth.
chunks.note: 原句 now is；把责任明确给对象。
chunks.quote: What is required of us now is a new era of responsibility, a recognition on the part of every American that we have duties to ourselves, our Nation, and the world.

chunks.chunk: firm in the knowledge that 从句
chunks.note: 不声称日常口语套语。
chunks.quote: Duties that we do not grudgingly accept but, rather, seize gladly, firm in the knowledge that there is nothing so satisfying to the spirit, so defining of our character, than giving our all to a difficult task.

chunks.note: all 指全部努力，不是全部财物。
chunks.quote: Duties that we do not grudgingly accept but, rather, seize gladly, firm in the knowledge that there is nothing so satisfying to the spirit, so defining of our character, than giving our all to a difficult task.

chunks.chunk: call on sb. to do sth.
chunks.note: 与 call for sth. 接法和对象不同。
chunks.quote: This is the source of our confidence—the knowledge that God calls on us to shape an uncertain destiny.

chunks.note: 原句 celebration；不同于 join 某个组织。
chunks.quote: This is the meaning of our liberty and our creed; why men and women and children of every race and every faith can join in celebration across this magnificent Mall, and why a man whose father less than 60 years ago might not have been served at a local restaurant can now stand before you to take a most sacred oath.

chunks.meaning: 某人已经走了多远；取得多少进展
chunks.note: 原句 traveled 有旅程意象，非固定政治口号。
chunks.quote: So let us mark this day with remembrance of who we are and how far we have traveled.

chunks.note: 原句 outcome ... most in doubt 表示结果最悬而未决。
chunks.quote: At a moment when the outcome of our Revolution was most in doubt, the Father of our Nation ordered these words be read to the people:

chunks.meaning: 只有某事；除了某事别无其他
chunks.note: 原句为历史引文，nothing but 严格保留限制范围。
chunks.quote: "Let it be told to the future world . . . that in the depth of winter, when nothing but hope and virtue could survive . . . that the city and the country, alarmed at one common danger, came forth to meet [it]."

chunks.note: 不是看着某人脸的字面义。
chunks.quote: America, in the face of our common dangers, in this winter of our hardship, let us remember these timeless words.

chunks.note: 可明确表达不愿让某结果发生，未推定用户已掌握。
chunks.quote: Let it be said by our children's children that when we were tested, we refused to let this journey end; that we did not turn back, nor did we falter.

chunks.note: 用于说明一种事实的存在，语气庄重。
chunks.quote: Each time we gather to inaugurate a President we bear witness to the enduring strength of our Constitution.

chunks.chunk: What makes sb./sth. + 形容词 is sth.
chunks.meaning: 使某人／某物具有某种特点的是……
chunks.note: 原句两次 what makes 重复为演讲强调，表达结构可迁移。
chunks.quote: What makes us exceptional—what makes us American—is our allegiance to an idea articulated in a declaration made more than two centuries ago:

chunks.note: 保留替换方向，不因基本词而删除。
chunks.quote: The patriots of 1776 did not fight to replace the tyranny of a king with the privileges of a few or the rule of a mob.

chunks.note: 比普通 promise 庄重。
chunks.quote: We made ourselves anew, and vowed to move forward together.

chunks.note: 原句集体确定社会需要，非 determine to 决心接法。
chunks.quote: Together, we determined that a modern economy requires railroads and highways to speed travel and commerce, schools and colleges to train our workers.

chunks.note: 不限体育场景。
chunks.quote: Together, we discovered that a free market only thrives when there are rules to ensure competition and fair play.

chunks.note: 原句照顾弱势者，不是喜欢某人的义项。
chunks.quote: Together, we resolved that a great nation must care for the vulnerable and protect its people from life's worst hazards and misfortune.

chunks.meaning: 在经历这一切的过程中始终
chunks.note: 承接此前讲述的困难或变化。
chunks.quote: Through it all, we have never relinquished our skepticism of central authority nor have we succumbed to the fiction that all society's ills can be cured through government alone.

chunks.note: 此处是接受一种虚构观点，不单列 succumb 义项。
chunks.quote: Through it all, we have never relinquished our skepticism of central authority nor have we succumbed to the fiction that all society's ills can be cured through government alone.

chunks.note: on 后名词或 doing，不是 insist to。
chunks.quote: Our celebration of initiative and enterprise, our insistence on hard work and personal responsibility, these are constants in our character.

chunks.chunk: when sth. changes, so must sb./sth.
chunks.meaning: 某事变化，某人／物也必须变化
chunks.note: so 引倒装表示同样，原句 times change, so must we。
chunks.quote: But we have always understood that when times change, so must we; that fidelity to our founding principles requires new responses to new challenges; that preserving our individual freedoms ultimately requires collective action.

chunks.chunk: can no more do A than do B
chunks.meaning: A 与 B 一样都做不到
chunks.note: 不同于 no more than 的数量限制；须完整看两端。
chunks.quote: For the American people can no more meet the demands of today's world by acting alone than American soldiers could have met the forces of fascism or communism with muskets and militias.

chunks.meaning: 现在比以往任何时候更……
chunks.note: 接当前尤其迫切的需求。
chunks.quote: Now more than ever, we must do these things together, as one nation and one people.

chunks.note: steel 为动词，不是钢材名词。
chunks.quote: This generation of Americans has been tested by crises that steeled our resolve and proved our resilience.

chunks.note: gift 非此处礼物；原句 a gift for reinvention。
chunks.quote: America's possibilities are limitless, for we possess all the qualities that this world without boundaries demands: youth and drive; diversity and openness; an endless capacity for risk and a gift for reinvention.

chunks.note: 原句把团结设为成功条件，不指时长。
chunks.quote: My fellow Americans, we are made for this moment and we will seize it—so long as we seize it together.

chunks.note: 此处经济处境，非赶上车或考试通过义。
chunks.quote: For we, the people, understand that our country cannot succeed when a shrinking few do very well and a growing many barely make it.

chunks.meaning: 濒临／摆脱某种险境边缘
chunks.note: 原句 from the brink of hardship 表示脱离困境边缘。
chunks.quote: We know that America thrives when every person can find independence and pride in their work; when the wages of honest labor liberate families from the brink of hardship.

chunks.chunk: have the same chance to do sth. as sb.
chunks.meaning: 有与某人同样的机会做某事
chunks.note: same 后保留 as 对照对象。
chunks.quote: We are true to our creed when a little girl born into the bleakest poverty knows that she has the same chance to succeed as anybody else, because she is an American; she is free and she is equal, not just in the eyes of God, but also in our own.

chunks.meaning: 在某人看来；按某人的评价
chunks.note: 此处分别说 God 与我们，不是视力。
chunks.quote: We are true to our creed when a little girl born into the bleakest poverty knows that she has the same chance to succeed as anybody else, because she is an American; she is free and she is equal, not just in the eyes of God, but also in our own.

chunks.chunk: inadequate to the needs of sth.
chunks.meaning: 不足以满足某事的需要
chunks.note: 可用于说明旧办法无法应对新要求。
chunks.quote: We understand that outworn programs are inadequate to the needs of our time.

chunks.meaning: 无人可求助；无处寻求支持
chunks.note: turn 此处是求助，不是转弯。
chunks.quote: For we remember the lessons of our past, when twilight years were spent in poverty and parents of a child with a disability had nowhere to turn.

chunks.chunk: choose between doing A and doing B
chunks.meaning: 在两种做法之间作选择
chunks.note: 原句 reject belief 反对被迫二选一。
chunks.quote: But we reject the belief that America must choose between caring for the generation that built this country and investing in the generation that will build its future.

chunks.chunk: no matter how + 形容词/副词 + 从句
chunks.note: 此处 responsibly，主句仍可能遭遇不幸。
chunks.quote: We recognize that no matter how responsibly we live our lives, any one of us at any time may face a job loss or a sudden illness or a home swept away in a terrible storm.

chunks.meaning: 仅留给某些人；专供某人
chunks.note: 原句否定自由只属于幸运者。
chunks.quote: We do not believe that in this country freedom is reserved for the lucky, or happiness for the few.

chunks.meaning: 使某人能够放开手去做某事
chunks.note: 不是本句收费义；解除限制、创造条件。
chunks.quote: They do not make us a nation of takers; they free us to take the risks that make this country great.

chunks.note: 名词结构可作主语，适合分析后果。
chunks.quote: We will respond to the threat of climate change, knowing that the failure to do so would betray our children and future generations.

chunks.note: lend 在此不是借钱；不将 creed 政治词写进泛化形式。
chunks.quote: That's what will lend meaning to the creed our fathers once declared.

chunks.note: too well 强调常因痛苦经历而熟知。
chunks.quote: Our citizens, seared by the memory of those we have lost, know too well the price that is paid for liberty.

chunks.note: harm 作名词，区别 do harm to sth. 接法。
chunks.quote: The knowledge of their sacrifice will keep us forever vigilant against those who would do us harm.

chunks.note: 不是抹掉所有差别；通常通过协商。
chunks.quote: We will show the courage to try and resolve our differences with other nations peacefully—not because we are naive about the dangers we face, but because engagement can more durably lift suspicion and fear.

chunks.chunk: not because 从句, but because 从句
chunks.note: 与 not out of 名词 的接法有独立差异，不据课本出现排除。
chunks.quote: We will show the courage to try and resolve our differences with other nations peacefully—not because we are naive about the dangers we face, but because engagement can more durably lift suspicion and fear.

chunks.meaning: 某事关系到自身利益；有利害关系
chunks.note: 此处世界和平关系到国家利益；非仅指股权。
chunks.quote: And we will renew those institutions that extend our capacity to manage crisis abroad, for no one has a greater stake in a peaceful world than its most powerful nation.

chunks.meaning: 代表某人；为某人的利益
chunks.note: 原句为自由渴望者发声，不只代理签字。
chunks.quote: We will support democracy from Asia to Africa, from the Americas to the Middle East, because our interests and our conscience compel us to act on behalf of those who long for freedom.

chunks.meaning: 与某事不可分割地联系在一起
chunks.note: 语域比 be linked to 更庄重。
chunks.quote: our individual freedom is inextricably bound to the freedom of every soul on Earth.

chunks.chunk: sth. is not complete until 从句
chunks.note: 原段多次重复；可迁移到项目验收条件。
chunks.quote: For our journey is not complete until our wives, our mothers and daughters can earn a living equal to their efforts.

chunks.note: 不是单纯赚一笔钱。
chunks.quote: For our journey is not complete until our wives, our mothers and daughters can earn a living equal to their efforts.

chunks.chunk: exercise the right to do sth.
chunks.note: exercise 非锻炼义。
chunks.quote: Our journey is not complete until no citizen is forced to wait for hours to exercise the right to vote.

chunks.note: from 接威胁来源，此处概括 harm。
chunks.quote: Our journey is not complete until all our children, from the streets of Detroit to the hills of Appalachia, to the quiet lanes of Newtown, know that they are cared for and cherished and always safe from harm.

chunks.chunk: doing sth. does not require sb. to do sth.
chunks.meaning: 做一件事并不要求某人做另一件事
chunks.note: 避免把必要条件强加给对方。
chunks.quote: Being true to our founding documents does not require us to agree on every contour of life.

chunks.chunk: It does not mean 从句
chunks.note: it 回指前述主张；保留外层否定推论动作。
chunks.quote: It does not mean we all define liberty in exactly the same way or follow the same precise path to happiness.

chunks.note: 原句非要求一次解决永久争论。
chunks.quote: Progress does not compel us to settle centuries-long debates about the role of government for all time, but it does require us to act in our time.

chunks.note: afford 指代价承受，不指支付延期费。
chunks.quote: For now decisions are upon us and we cannot afford delay.

chunks.note: 不要颠倒对象。
chunks.quote: We cannot mistake absolutism for principle or substitute spectacle for politics or treat name-calling as reasoned debate.

chunks.note: 与 replace A with B 的宾语方向不同。
chunks.quote: We cannot mistake absolutism for principle or substitute spectacle for politics or treat name-calling as reasoned debate.

chunks.meaning: 把某事当作另一种事来对待
chunks.note: 原句批评把辱骂当成理性讨论。
chunks.quote: We cannot mistake absolutism for principle or substitute spectacle for politics or treat name-calling as reasoned debate.

chunks.chunk: It will be up to sb. to do sth.
chunks.note: 不是某人能否做到的能力判断。
chunks.quote: We must act, we must act knowing that today's victories will be only partial and that it will be up to those who stand here in 4 years and 40 years and 400 years hence to advance the timeless spirit once conferred to us in a spare Philadelphia hall.

chunks.meaning: 在知道／清楚……的情况下行动
chunks.note: knowing本身不自动等于明知却仍；原句承认行动的成果可能不完美。
chunks.quote: We must act, knowing that our work will be imperfect.

chunks.meaning: 与某事并没有那么不同
chunks.note: so 限定差异程度，不完全等同。
chunks.quote: But the words I spoke today are not so different from the oath that is taken each time a soldier signs up for duty or an immigrant realizes her dream.

chunks.note: 普通交流可理解，但此场景庄重。
chunks.quote: My oath is not so different from the pledge we all make to the flag that waves above and that fills our hearts with pride.

chunks.meaning: 为维护某事；为某事辩护
chunks.note: 不只是军事防御。
chunks.quote: You and I, as citizens, have the obligation to shape the debates of our time—not only with the votes we cast, but with the voices we lift in defense of our most ancient values and enduring ideals.

chunks.note: 原句 history 是修辞；常用在使命或责任，非普通电话。
chunks.quote: With common effort and common purpose, with passion and dedication, let us answer the call of history and carry into an uncertain future that precious light of freedom.

chunks.chunk: It is a rare honor to do sth.
chunks.meaning: 能做某事是难得的荣幸
chunks.note: 可用于介绍嘉宾或承接机会；rare 强调难得。
chunks.quote: It is a rare honor in this life to follow one of your heroes.

chunks.chunk: I have to imagine that 从句
chunks.note: 原句从历史人物处境作推测，非已核实心理事实。
chunks.quote: Now, I have to imagine that when a younger John Lewis woke up that morning 50 years ago and made his way to Brown Chapel, heroics were not on his mind.

chunks.note: 常含过程或行进意味；不等同 make way for。
chunks.quote: Now, I have to imagine that when a younger John Lewis woke up that morning 50 years ago and made his way to Brown Chapel, heroics were not on his mind.

chunks.note: 原句否定表示当时未考虑英雄行为。
chunks.quote: Now, I have to imagine that when a younger John Lewis woke up that morning 50 years ago and made his way to Brown Chapel, heroics were not on his mind.

chunks.note: 通常群体无明确方向地移动。
chunks.quote: Young folks with bedrolls and backpacks were milling about.

chunks.note: 此处 instructions；scribble 表潦草或快速。
chunks.quote: A doctor described what tear gas does to the body, while marchers scribbled down instructions for contacting their loved ones.

chunks.meaning: 亲近的家人或所爱之人
chunks.note: 不限定恋人。
chunks.quote: A doctor described what tear gas does to the body, while marchers scribbled down instructions for contacting their loved ones.

chunks.note: 原句空气充满怀疑、期待与害怕；不声称普通口语高频。
chunks.quote: The air was thick with doubt, anticipation, and fear.

chunks.note: bars 为牢房铁栏，不是酒吧。
chunks.quote: And then, his knapsack stocked with an apple, a toothbrush, and a book on government—all you need for a night behind bars—John Lewis led them out of the church on a mission to change America.

chunks.chunk: on a mission to do sth.
chunks.meaning: 怀着明确使命去做某事
chunks.note: 可用于认真目标，随意场景也可能幽默夸张。
chunks.quote: And then, his knapsack stocked with an apple, a toothbrush, and a book on government—all you need for a night behind bars—John Lewis led them out of the church on a mission to change America.

chunks.meaning: 孤立地；脱离相关背景地
chunks.note: 原句反对孤立分析历史事件。
chunks.quote: Now, as is true across the landscape of American history, we cannot examine this moment in isolation.

chunks.meaning: 某个更广泛事物的一部分
chunks.note: 可说明事件属于更大过程，非固定习语。
chunks.quote: The march on Selma was part of a broader campaign that spanned generations, the leaders that day part of a long line of heroes.

chunks.meaning: 始终忠于某个原则或目标
chunks.note: 与 remain faithful to 接近，合并时可作为变体。
chunks.quote: men and women who despite the gush of blood and splintered bone would stay true to their north star and keep marching towards justice.

chunks.note: 不等于过去那些天。
chunks.quote: They did as Scripture instructed: "Rejoice in hope, be patient in tribulation, be constant in prayer." And in the days to come, they went back again and again.

chunks.note: 此处不是及时赶到的 in time 义。
chunks.quote: In time, their chorus would well up and reach President Johnson.

chunks.note: 原句否定，强调争取平等待遇。
chunks.quote: But they didn't seek special treatment, just the equal treatment promised to them almost a century before.

chunks.note: 承接已提到的过去时期。
chunks.quote: Back then, they were called Communists or half-breeds or outside agitators, sexual and moral degenerates, and worse.

chunks.note: 原句表达各式辱称却不叫本名；but 为 except。
chunks.quote: They were called everything but the name their parents gave them.

chunks.chunk: What could be more + 形容词 + than sth.?
chunks.note: 用于强调极高评价，不是求事实答案。
chunks.quote: And yet what could be more American than what happened in this place?

chunks.chunk: It is in sb.'s power to do sth.
chunks.meaning: 某人有能力或权力做某事
chunks.note: 此处强调公民能够改变国家，非必然成功。
chunks.quote: it is in our power to remake this Nation to more closely align with our highest ideals?

chunks.meaning: 与某种目标或标准一致
chunks.note: 此处 ideals；非只物理对齐。
chunks.quote: it is in our power to remake this Nation to more closely align with our highest ideals?

chunks.note: 连接前面的理由和结果，不据易懂而排除。
chunks.quote: That's why their Selma is not some outlier in the American experience.

chunks.note: 不是 call 的单独电话义。
chunks.quote: They're a living thing, a call to action, a roadmap for citizenship, and an insistence in the capacity of free men and women to shape our own destiny.

chunks.note: 此处积极参与自治工作。
chunks.quote: the success of our experiment in self-government rested on engaging all of our citizens in this work.

chunks.chunk: That's what sth. is all about
chunks.meaning: 这正是某事的核心意义
chunks.note: all about 不指所有细节。
chunks.quote: That's what this movement was all about, one leg in our long journey toward freedom.

chunks.meaning: 接过前人的事业继续做
chunks.note: 不是每个普通工作交接都适用。
chunks.quote: The American instinct that led these young men and women to pick up the torch and cross this bridge, that's the same instinct that moved patriots to choose revolution over tyranny.

chunks.note: 可用于产品、项目或自身成长。
chunks.quote: It's the idea held by generations of citizens who believed that America is a constant work in progress, who believed that loving this country requires more than singing its praises or avoiding uncomfortable truths.

chunks.note: 不是字面唱歌；有时可带过度吹捧意味。
chunks.quote: It's the idea held by generations of citizens who believed that America is a constant work in progress, who believed that loving this country requires more than singing its praises or avoiding uncomfortable truths.

chunks.note: speak out 常强调不保持沉默。
chunks.quote: It requires the occasional disruption, the willingness to speak out for what is right, to shake up the status quo.

chunks.note: shake up 并非简单摇晃。
chunks.quote: It requires the occasional disruption, the willingness to speak out for what is right, to shake up the status quo.

chunks.meaning: 从某事中获得力量／支持
chunks.note: 此处历史事件给予继续行动的勇气。
chunks.quote: From the streets of Tunis to the Maidan in Ukraine, this generation of young people can draw strength from this place, where the powerless could change the world's greatest power and push their leaders to expand the boundaries of freedom.

chunks.meaning: 巩固作为某种角色的声誉
chunks.note: cement 为比喻巩固；非水泥义。
chunks.quote: That's what cements our reputation as a beacon of opportunity.

chunks.meaning: 屈从于某种统治或要求
chunks.note: 此处军事统治，非提交文件。
chunks.quote: Young people in Burma went to prison rather than submit to military rule.

chunks.meaning: 这就引出我们要问的问题……
chunks.note: which 回指前述整件事，不应当作独立完整句模板。
chunks.quote: Which leads us to ask, just how might we repay that debt?

chunks.note: 兼有首要重要性，不仅是时间先后。
chunks.quote: First and foremost, we have to recognize that one day's commemoration, no matter how special, is not enough.

chunks.chunk: If sth. taught us anything, it's that 从句
chunks.meaning: 如果某事教给我们什么，那就是……
chunks.note: 强调最重要教训，非怀疑有没有学到东西。
chunks.quote: If Selma taught us anything, it's that our work is never done.

chunks.meaning: 说到某个领域；涉及某事时
chunks.note: to 为介词，后可接 doing。
chunks.quote: For when it comes to the pursuit of justice, we can afford neither complacency nor despair.

chunks.meaning: 关于某事；就某方面而言
chunks.note: 此处不是尊敬某事。
chunks.quote: Just this week, I was asked whether I thought the Department of Justice's Ferguson report shows that, with respect to race, little has changed in this country.

chunks.chunk: reject the notion that 从句
chunks.note: notion 引出被反对的主张。
chunks.quote: But I rejected the notion that nothing's changed.

chunks.chunk: I was asked whether 从句
chunks.note: 被动引入别人提出的问题，不需添加提问者。
chunks.quote: Just this week, I was asked whether I thought the Department of Justice's Ferguson report shows that, with respect to race, little has changed in this country.

chunks.meaning: 对某人／事业帮倒忙或造成不公
chunks.note: 原句指把歧视说成永恒不变反而损害正义。
chunks.quote: We do a disservice to the cause of justice by intimating that bias and discrimination are immutable, that racial division is inherent in America.

chunks.meaning: 亲身经历某段时期或困难
chunks.note: 不同于住在某处。
chunks.quote: If you think nothing's changed in the past 50 years, ask somebody who lived through the Selma or Chicago or Los Angeles of the 1950s.

chunks.note: 可抽象搭配 agency、chance，不只财物抢劫。
chunks.quote: To deny this progress, this hard-won progress—our progress—would be to rob us of our own agency, our own capacity, our responsibility to do what we can to make America better.

chunks.note: 原句反对把事件说成个案；非 isolated 人际孤独义。
chunks.quote: Of course, a more common mistake is to suggest that Ferguson is an isolated incident, that racism is banished, that the work that drew men and women to Selma is now complete, and that whatever racial tensions remain are a consequence of those seeking to play the "race card" for their own purposes.

chunks.note: 原句带借题发挥的负面评价。
chunks.quote: those seeking to play the "race card" for their own purposes.

chunks.note: 原句 long 加强持续历史影响；可迁移但保留比喻语气。
chunks.quote: We just need to open our eyes and our ears and our hearts to know that this Nation's racial history still casts its long shadow upon us.

chunks.chunk: We don't need sth. to know that 从句
chunks.meaning: 不用某种证据／条件我们也知道……
chunks.note: 可能是强势立场，不能自动替代实际查证。
chunks.quote: We don't need a Ferguson report to know that's not true.

chunks.note: 原句 truth；不等同 face down 的对抗。
chunks.quote: We know that reaching that blessed destination where we are judged, all of us, by the content of our character requires admitting as much, facing up to the truth.

chunks.note: 原句 Baldwin 引文，须保留引文语境。
chunks.quote: "We are capable of bearing a great burden," James Baldwin once wrote, "once we discover that the burden is reality and arrive where reality is."

chunks.note: 不是物理看成正方形。
chunks.quote: There's nothing America can't handle if we actually look squarely at the problem.

chunks.note: 原句被动 consensus can be built，非统一全部意见。
chunks.quote: And if we make such an effort, no matter how hard it may sometimes seem, laws can be passed and consciences can be stirred and consensus can be built.

chunks.chunk: There's nothing sb. can't handle if 从句
chunks.meaning: 只要……，某人没有应付不了的事
chunks.note: 双重否定强化信心，原句条件是直面问题；不是事实保证。
chunks.quote: There's nothing America can't handle if we actually look squarely at the problem.

chunks.chunk: risk sb.'s life to do sth.
chunks.note: 用于真实重大危险，不泛化为普通工作风险。
chunks.quote: Together, we can raise the level of mutual trust that policing is built on: the idea that police officers are members of the community they risk their lives to protect.

chunks.meaning: 不承担成本或责任而享受好处
chunks.note: 此处并非免费乘车。
chunks.quote: Americans don't accept a free ride for anybody, nor do we believe in equality of outcomes.

chunks.meaning: 口头支持某事却不付诸行动
chunks.note: 不可把 lip service 当积极认可。
chunks.quote: And if we really mean it, if we're not just giving lip service to it, but if we really mean it and are willing to sacrifice for it,

chunks.meaning: 如果某人当真／是认真说的
chunks.note: 原句与实际牺牲连接，非 mean 单词释义。
chunks.quote: And if we really mean it, if we're not just giving lip service to it, but if we really mean it and are willing to sacrifice for it,

chunks.meaning: 就在此刻；我们说话的同时
chunks.note: 不是就说话方式而言。
chunks.quote: As we speak, more such laws are being proposed.

chunks.note: 原句 so much 插入各名词；不认为字面每项都出现。
chunks.quote: Meanwhile, the Voting Rights Act, the culmination of so much blood, so much sweat and tears, the product of so much sacrifice in the face of wanton violence, the Voting Rights Act stands weakened, its future subject to political rancor.

chunks.note: 此处反对现状，非仅请求说明。
chunks.quote: How can that be?

chunks.chunk: make it sb.'s mission to do sth.
chunks.meaning: 把做某事当作自己的使命
chunks.note: 语气比 take on a task 更强。
chunks.quote: If we want to honor this day, let that hundred go back to Washington and gather 400 more, and together, pledge to make it their mission to restore that law this year.

chunks.note: 原句被动 struck down；不是普通否决建议。
chunks.quote: If every new voter suppression law was struck down today, we would still have, here in America, one of the lowest voting rates among free peoples.

chunks.chunk: What's sb.'s excuse for doing/not doing sth.?
chunks.meaning: 某人做／不做某事有什么理由？
chunks.note: 常带反诘责备，非礼貌中性询问。
chunks.quote: What's our excuse today for not voting?

chunks.chunk: take the time to do sth.
chunks.note: 不只是耗时。
chunks.quote: Why are we pointing to somebody else when we could take the time just to go to the polling places?

chunks.note: 这里珍惜便利，非假设一条命题为真。
chunks.quote: We take for granted conveniences that our parents could have scarcely imagined.

chunks.note: 此处参军；不把战争内容写成默认对象。

chunks.note: 原 Emerson 引文，非站得快。

chunks.note: 经济与职场搭配。

chunks.note: 宣誓承诺履行职责，不是随意许愿。

chunks.note: 不是仅仅把东西提供给某人。

chunks.quote: Posterity is the world to come: the world for whom we hold our ideals, from whom we have borrowed our planet, and to whom we bear sacred responsibility.

chunks.quote: Powerful people maneuver for position and worry endlessly about who is in and who is out, who is up and who is down, forgetting those people whose toil and sweat sends us here and pays our way.

chunks.note: 可字面指会场，也可比喻权势压制。

chunks.note: 原演讲语境；可按原意迁移，不因出现一次宣称高频。
chunks.quote: This beautiful Capital, like every capital since the dawn of civilization, is often a place of intrigue and calculation.

chunks.note: meet不是碰面。

chunks.note: 常用于责任、困难或行动。

chunks.quote: While America rebuilds at home, we will not shrink from the challenges nor fail to seize the opportunities of this new world.

chunks.note: 常见形式也有be a testament to。

chunks.note: 这里不只是提高音量，而是参与公共表达。

chunks.note: 通常指重大、明显的变化。

chunks.note: 原演讲语境；可按原意迁移，不因出现一次宣称高频。
chunks.quote: But no President, no Congress, no Government can undertake this mission alone.

chunks.meaning: 奉献自己的时间、精力或能力

chunks.quote: There is so much to be done; enough, indeed, for millions of others who are still young in spirit to give of themselves in service, too.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 带接受而不再强求的语气。
chunks.quote: measure of me and my heart. And if you still disagree, so be it. That's democracy. That's America. The right to dissent peaceably, within the guardrails of our Republic, is perhaps this Nation's greatest strength. Yet hear me clearly: Disagreement must not lead to disunion. And I pledge this to you: I will be a President for all Americans—all Americans. And I promise you, I will fight as hard for those who did not support me as for those who did.

chunks.chunk: fight as hard for A as for B
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 保留比较表达结构；fight 可指积极争取。
chunks.quote: And I promise you, I will fight as hard for those who did not support me as for those who did.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Recent weeks and months have taught us a painful lesson.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 同理回应；此处不是收到了物品。
chunks.quote: Look, I understand that many of my fellow Americans view the future with fear and trepidation. I understand they worry about their jobs. I understand, like my dad, they lay at bed at night staring at the ceiling, wondering: "Can I keep my health care? Can I pay my mortgage?" Thinking about their families, about what comes next. I promise you, I get it. But the answer is not to turn inward, to retreat into competing factions, distrusting those who don't look like you or worship the way you do or don't get their news from the same sources you do. We must end this uncivil war that pits red against blue, rural versus urban, conservative versus liberal. We can do this if we open our souls instead of hardening our hearts, if we show a little tolerance and humility, and if we're willing to stand in the other person's shoes, as my mom would say, just for a moment. Stand in their shoes.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。

Stand in their shoes.

chunks.chunk: stand in the other person's shoes
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲

chunks.quote: We can do this if we open our souls instead of hardening our hearts, if we show a little tolerance and humility, and if we're willing to stand in the other person's shoes, as my mom would say, just for a moment.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语引出解释。
chunks.quote: Because here is the thing about life: There is no accounting for what fate will deal you.

chunks.chunk: There is no accounting for sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 本句面对命运的不可预知；固定说法并非会计。
chunks.quote: Because here is the thing about life: There is no accounting for what fate will deal you.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: There are other days when we're called to lend a hand.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And I promise you this: As the Bible says, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning." We will get through this, together—together.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: for it 指因为经历了考验。
chunks.quote: So here is my message to those beyond our borders: America has been tested, and we have come out stronger for it.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Look, you all know, we have been through so much in this Nation.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: So I ask you, let's say a silent prayer for those who have lost their lives, for those they left behind, and for our country.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: But the fact is, we face them all at once, presenting this Nation with one of the gravest of responsibilities we've had.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Now we're going to be tested. Are we going to step up? All of us? It is time for boldness, for there is so much to do. And this is certain, I promise you: We will be judged, you and I, by how we resolve these cascading crises of our era. Will we rise to the occasion, is the question. Will we master this rare and difficult hour? Will we meet our obligations and pass along a new and better world to our children? I believe we must; I'm sure you do as well. I believe we will.

chunks.meaning: 在关键时刻发挥出应有能力
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 与rise to the challenge近义，场合触发点有独立边界。
chunks.quote: Will we rise to the occasion, is the question.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And when we do, we will write the next great chapter in the history of the United States of America: the American story, a story that might sound something like a song that means a lot to me. It's called "American Anthem," and there's one verse that stands out, at least for me, and it goes like this:

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Let's add—let's us add our own work and prayers to the unfolding story of our great Nation. If we do this, then when our days are through, our children and our children's children will say of us: "They gave their best. They did their duty. They healed a broken land."

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: My fellow Americans, I close today where I began, with a sacred oath. Before God and all of you I give you my word: I will always level with you. I will defend the Constitution. I will defend our democracy. I will defend America. And I will give all, all of you, keep everything you—I do, in your service, thinking not of power, but of possibilities; not of personal interest, but of the public good. And together, we shall write an American story of hope, not fear; of unity, not division; of light, not darkness. A story of decency and dignity, love and healing, greatness and goodness.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语；不是与某人保持水平。
chunks.quote: Before God and all of you I give you my word: I will always level with you.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 强调负责期间发生的事情。
chunks.quote: May this be the story that guides us, the story that inspires us, and the story that tells ages yet to come that we answered the call of history, we met the moment; democracy and hope, truth and justice, did not die on our watch, but thrived; that America secured liberty at home and stood once again as a beacon to the world. That is what we owe our forebearers, one another, and generations to follow.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: So with purpose and resolve we turn to those tasks of our time, sustained by faith, driven by conviction, and devoted to one another and the country we love with all our hearts.

chunks.chunk: put more meat on the bone
chunks.meaning: 把内容讲得更充实、更具体
chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语比喻；补充实质信息。
chunks.quote: The President. Thank you, thank you. Please, please, sit down. Thank you. I'm going to put a little bit more meat on that bone—that last one. [Laughter]

chunks.meaning: 被分配到某单位／某任务
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: John and I used to travel together. When John got back from all that time in Vietnam in prison, when he was released, he decided he wanted to go back to stay in the military. And he was assigned to the United States Senate and to the military office there that travels with Senators when they travel abroad.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And John and I put in a couple hundred thousand miles together. And on our way to—I think I was going to either China—I forget what the destination was—China, I think. And we stopped in Hawaii. And the Chief Naval—of Operations was there showing me around. They did an event for me.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Well, as your mom come—I won't go into more detail, but I'll tell you: I insisted that they meet.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 可中性认领贡献，也可能负面指抢功。
chunks.quote: I take credit for you guys.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: [Laughter] And I just told your mom: John and I had something in common, we both married way above our station— [laughter]—way above our station.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 旧式阶层措辞，此处自嘲奉承伴侣，不是现代日常默认模板。
chunks.quote: Well, as your mom come—I won't go into more detail, but I'll tell you: I insisted that they meet. [Laughter] And I take credit. I take credit for you guys. [Laughter] And I just told your mom: John and I had something in common, we both married way above our station— [laughter]—way above our station.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语引入建议或强调；本句用于强调荣幸。
chunks.quote: [Laughter] Well, I tell you what, it's an honor to be with you.

chunks.meaning: 在某人联系时能够响应
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原文双方回报支持；非每次都必须24小时待命。这里指随时能联系并给予响应，when从句不是固定必要部分。
chunks.quote: Governor Hobbs, you've done an incredible job. You've been a leader and defender of democracy. And you've always been available when I've called, and I hope I've been available when you called as well.

chunks.meaning: 放弃、抛下某种承诺或理念
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: We've never fully lived up to that idea, but we've never walked away from it. But there's danger we're walking too far away from it now, the way we talk in this debate—in this country. Because a long line of patriots from—like John McCain kept it from ever becoming something other than what it is.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语，hell为加强语气，不宜正式协商。
chunks.quote: We'd argue like hell.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语；依语境也可指打斗。
chunks.quote: [Laughter] I mean really go at one another.

chunks.quote: [Laughter] No, but it's—you've got to admit, Cindy, I did.

chunks.quote: I talked to him, and I said: "John, you can do this job. My only worry is, you'll do it too well." [Laughter]

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 插入语，突出额外信息。
chunks.quote: I was there to usher in a 50-year arc of progress for the two countries, pushed by John and, I might add, another John— this is the former Secretary of State, John from Massachusetts, won the Silver Star as well.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 此处在纪念地点致敬。
chunks.quote: As I stood there paying my respects, I thought about how much I missed my friend. And it's not hyperbole. I—from the bottom of my heart, I mean this.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 情绪比喻；本句heart与conscience并列。
chunks.quote: You see, John's one of those patriots who, when they die, their voices are never silent. They still speak to us. They tug at both our hearts and our conscience. And they pose the most profound questions: Who are we? What do we stand for? What do we believe? What will we be? For John, it was country first. Sounds like a movie, but it's real with John: honor, duty, decency, freedom, liberty, democracy.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语，控制打断。
chunks.quote: Well, hang on one second. Hang on a second.

chunks.quote: Hang on a second. I'll be happy to meet with you after I speak, okay?

chunks.quote: The President. Well, I tell you what, if you shush up, I'll meet with you immediately after this. Okay?

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 论述开场。
chunks.quote: Let me begin with the core principles.

chunks.note: 正式。
chunks.quote: And democracy means respecting the institutions that govern a free society. That means adhering to the timeless words of the Declaration of Independence: "We hold these truths to be self-evident." A mission statement embodied in our Constitution, our system of separation of powers and checks and balances.

chunks.chunk: one way or no way at all
chunks.meaning: 只容许一种做法，否则就不行
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 强硬的非黑即白态度；不当礼貌协商模板。
chunks.quote: Our Constitution—the bulwark to prevent the abuse of power to ensure "We the People" move forward together under the law, rather than believing the only way is one way or no way at all.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 本句while为让步，不是同时发生。
chunks.quote: These principles of democracy are essential in a free society, but they have always been embattled. Today let's be clear. While we've made progress, democracy is still at risk. This is not hyperbole; it's a simple truth—a simple truth.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 立场强调。
chunks.quote: Today let's be clear.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 带不满或遗憾。
chunks.quote: Today, in America [Arizona; White House correction], to honor an institution devoted to the defense of democracy, named in honor of a true patriot, I'm here to speak about another threat to our democracy that we all too often ignore: the threat to our political institutions, to our Constitution itself, and the very character of our Nation.

chunks.meaning: 这不是可以任意选做的
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 明确责任边界。
chunks.quote: This adherence isn't—this isn't optional.

chunks.note: 邀请对方通过假设换位判断。
chunks.quote: President, what would you think if you picked up the paper tomorrow—tomorrow, the London Times—and it said a thousand people broke down the doors of Parliament, marched, and killed two bobbies in order to overthrow an election of the new Prime Minister?

chunks.quote: I'd be surprised if you heard anything different than the concern about: Are we okay?

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 确信，不等于没有人提问。
chunks.quote: But there is no question that today's Republican Party is driven and intimidated by MAGA Republican extremists.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 此处挡住晋升，非举起。
chunks.quote: Our U.S. military—and this in not hyperbole; I've said it for the last 2 years—is the strongest military in the history of the world. Not just the strongest in the world—in the history of the world. It's the most diverse, the most powerful in the history of the world. And it's being accused of being weak and "woke" by the opposition. One guy in Alabama is holding up the promotion of every—hundreds of these officers.

chunks.chunk: have no idea what 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 可中性承认不知，原句批评且含粗俗加强语。
chunks.quote: Frankly, these extremists have no idea what the hell they're talking about.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And this is a dangerous notion: This President is above the law, with no limits on power.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 偏书面。
chunks.quote: Trump says the Constitution gave him, quote, "the right to do whatever he wants as President," end of quote. I've never even heard a President say that in jest. Not guided by the Constitution or by common service and decency toward our fellow Americans, but by vengeance and vindictiveness.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 负面，比一般under control更指支配关系。
chunks.quote: Limit the independence of Federal agencies, put them under the thumb of a President?

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Not veto—he doesn't like what it's being spent for—it's there. Get rid of longstanding protections for civil servants?

chunks.note: 正式；政治／组织忠诚。
chunks.quote: These civil servants had to pledge loyalty to the President, not the Constitution.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 书面叙事；原为引述言论。
chunks.quote: "In times gone by, the punishment"—quote, "In times gone by, the punishment would've been death," end of quote.

chunks.meaning: 沉默本身极其显眼／令人震惊
