chunks.note: 比喻批评应发声而不发声。
chunks.quote: And although I don't believe even a majority of Republicans think that, the silence is deafening.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原句call out statements，非单纯大声叫喊。
chunks.quote: Hardly any Republican called out such heinous statements, just as they watch one MAGA Senator outrageously, as I said, blocking the promotions of hundreds of top military leaders and affecting not only those leaders but their families, their children.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: MAGA extremists claim support of our troops, but they're harming military readiness, leadership, troop morale, freezing pay, freezing military families in limbo.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Just as they looked the other way when the defeated former President refused to pay respects at an American cemetery near Paris, referring to the American servicemen buried there—and I've been to this cemetery—as "suckers" and "losers," quotes.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 强调事实真实性；可用于日常叙事。
chunks.quote: I'm not making this up.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: The MAGA extremists across the country have made it clear where they stand. So the challenge for the rest of America—for the majority of Americans—is to make clear where we stand.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: But I tried to do my very best to meet the highest standards, whether you voted for me or not.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I said: "Yes. In one word, possibilities."

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 容纳并列身份选项，外层限定表达结构。
chunks.quote: Which is why I'm asking you that regardless of whether you're a Democrat, Republican, or Independent, put the preservation of our democracy before everything else.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Over the past few years, we can and should be proud of American democracy, proud of what we've been able to hold on to.

chunks.chunk: I used to think that 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 叙述观点变化，不预设后来观点必然正确。
chunks.quote: Remember when you were in high school and college, if you took political science, they said every generation has to protect democracy. I used to think that that was just a saying.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 较形象，可说趋势复发。
chunks.quote: You know, toward the end of my Senate campaign, I convinced Strom Thurmond to vote for the civil rights legislation—not a joke—and I thought, "Well, you can defeat hate." You can't defeat it. You just bury it. But when someone comes along and lifts up the rock and breathes a little oxygen in there, it comes roaring back. It comes roaring back.

chunks.chunk: I'm not just trying to be nice
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 澄清称赞并非礼貌敷衍。
chunks.quote: And again, I'm not just trying to be nice here.

chunks.chunk: for the worse / for the better
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Our task—our sacred task of our time is to make sure that they change not for the worse, but for the better. That democracy survives and thrives, not be smashed by a movement more interested in power than in principle. It's up to us, the American people.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: In my view, the more people vote, the more engaged the whole Nation becomes, the stronger our democracy will be.

chunks.chunk: the more 从句, the stronger 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 关系表达结构；原文连续三个the比较级。
chunks.quote: In my view, the more people vote, the more engaged the whole Nation becomes, the stronger our democracy will be.

chunks.chunk: The answer to sth. is sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 此处answer不是试题答案。
chunks.quote: So the answer to the threats we face is engagement.

chunks.chunk: I know I don't look it, but 从句
chunks.meaning: 我知道外表看不出来，但……
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 轻松自我介绍；look it指看起来像那样。
chunks.quote: To the students here today and the young people across country, you're the reason I'm so optimistic. I know I don't look it, but I've been doing this for a long time.

chunks.meaning: 这不该由某人独自承担
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 分担责任。
chunks.quote: It's not your burden alone, but your generation will not be ignored, will not be shunned, will not be silenced.

chunks.note: 正式分析措辞，不将任何变化都夸为重大拐点。
chunks.quote: I've said it before: We're at an inflection point in our history.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: One of those moments that not only happens once every several generations, it happens once every eight or nine generations, where the decisions made in the short period of time we're in now are going to determine the course of this country and the world for the next six or seven decades.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: So you, me, every American who is committed to preserving our democracy and our constitutional protections, we carry a special responsibility. We have to stand up for American values embedded in the Constitution, the Declaration of Independence, because we know the MAGA extremists have already proven they won't.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And most important, our children and grandchildren will hold us responsible.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 结束论述套语。
chunks.quote: So let me close with this.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And that's why I've never been more optimistic about America's future. We just need to remember who we are. We are the United States of America. There is nothing—nothing—beyond our capacity when we act together.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 假设与现实不同；本句自嘲。
chunks.quote: Good evening. If I were smart, I'd go home now.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 强调意义，不是普通否定。
chunks.quote: And yes, my purpose tonight is to wake up the Congress and alert the American people that this is no ordinary moment either.

chunks.chunk: What makes sth. ... is that 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 外层解释表达结构。
chunks.quote: What makes our moment rare is that freedom and democracy are under attack at—both at home and overseas at the very same time.

chunks.meaning: 我向你保证／可以明确告诉你……
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: If anybody in this room thinks Putin will stop at Ukraine, I assure you: He will not.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 负面评价，不是默认礼貌服从。
chunks.quote: The President. That's a quote. A former President actually said that, bowing down to a Russian leader. I think it's outrageous, it's dangerous, and it's unacceptable.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: America is a founding member of NATO, the military alliance of democratic nations created after World War II prevent—to prevent war and keep the peace.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I say this to Congress: We have to stand up to Putin. Send me a bipartisan national security bill. History is literally watching. History is watching. If the United States walks away, it will put Ukraine at risk. Europe is at risk. The free world will be at risk, emboldening others to do what they wish to do us harm.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Many of you were here on that darkest of days. We all saw with our own eyes, the insurrectionists were not patriots. They had come to stop the peaceful transfer of power, to overturn the will of the people.

chunks.meaning: 某事本来绝不应该发生
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 对过去事件的评判。
chunks.quote: What her family had gone through should never have happened.

chunks.chunk: Unless 从句, it could happen again
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 提出防止复发的条件。
chunks.quote: Unless Congress acts, it could happen again.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Like most Americans, I believe Roe v. Wade got it right.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 负面语气。
chunks.quote: My predecessor came to office determined to see Roe v. Wade overturned. He's the reason it was overturned, and he brags about it. Look at the chaos that has resulted.

chunks.meaning: 恕我直言／容我表示不同意见
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 往往后接反对，未必减弱冒犯。
chunks.quote: Wade, the Supreme Court majority wrote the following—and with all due respect, Justices—"Women are not without electoral power"— excuse me—"electoral or political power." You're about to realize just how much you were right about that.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语，原句带批评。
chunks.quote: Wade have no clue about the power of women.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: So let's tell the story here—tell it here and now.

chunks.note: 演讲夸张评价，不当可核实事实。
chunks.quote: Now, our economy is literally the envy of the world: 15 million new jobs in just 3 years—a record, a record; unemployment at 50-year lows.

chunks.chunk: Where is it written (that) 从句?
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 反驳所谓不可突破的限制，修辞问句。
chunks.quote: Americans. Eight hundred thousand new manufacturing jobs in America and counting. Where is it written we can't be the manufacturing capital of the world? We are, and we will.

chunks.note: 正式法律／政策语域。
chunks.quote: "Buy America" has been the law of the land since the 1930s.

chunks.chunk: drive up the price of sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And thanks to our CHIPS and Science Act, the United States is investing more in research and development than ever before. During the pandemic, a shortage of semiconductors, chips that drove up the price of everything from cell phones to automobiles—and by the way, we invented those chips right here in America.

chunks.meaning: 为某人／某事加油、表示支持
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And by the way, I noticed some of you who've strongly voted against it are there cheering on that money coming in. [Laughter] And I like it. I'm with you. I'm with you. And if any of you don't want that money in your district, just let me know. [Laughter]

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 本句面对对手带调侃；并非地理位置。
chunks.quote: [Laughter] And I like it. I'm with you.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 安排沟通的套语。
chunks.quote: And if any of you don't want that money in your district, just let me know.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Because of my investment in family farms—[applause]—because I invested in family farms—led by my Secretary of Agriculture, who knows more about this than anybody I know— we're better able to stay in the family for the—those farms so their—and their children and grandchildren won't have to leave home to make a living.

chunks.chunk: be on sb.'s way to doing sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 这里即将关闭，不是人在路上。
chunks.quote: The great comeback story is Belvidere, Illinois. Home to an auto plant for nearly 60 years. Before I came to office, the plant was on its way to shutting down. Thousands of workers feared for their livelihoods. Hope was fading.

chunks.meaning: 被落下、被时代发展抛在后面
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Instead of auto factories shutting down, auto factories are reopening, and a new state-of-the- art battery factory is being built to power those cars there at the same—[applause]. Folks— [applause]. To the folks of Belvidere, I say: Instead of your town being left behind, your community is moving forward again. Because instead of watching auto jobs of the future go overseas, 4,000 union jobs with higher wages are building a future in Belvidere right here in America.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 财务搭配。
chunks.quote: The President. Tonight—tonight, I want to talk about the future of possibilities that we can build together, a future where the days of trickle-down economics are over and the wealthy and the biggest corporations no longer get the—all the tax breaks.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: That's why I determined to turn things around so the middle class does well.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 评价目前进展仍不足。
chunks.quote: And there's more to do to make sure you're feeling the benefits of all we're doing.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: healthy并非身体健康。
chunks.quote: Instead of paying $400 a month or thereabouts for insulin with diabetes—and it only costs 10 bucks to make—they only get paid $35 a month now and still make a healthy profit.

chunks.chunk: cap the cost of sth. at ...
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 政策和预算讨论。
chunks.quote: And I want to—and what to do next, I want to cap the cost of insulin at $35 a month for every American who needs it—everyone.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: This year, Medicare is negotiating lower prices for some of the costliest drugs on the market that treat everything from heart disease to arthritis.

chunks.chunk: get in trouble for doing sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Folks, I'm going to get in trouble for saying that, but any of you want to get in Air Force One with me and fly to Toronto, Berlin, Moscow—I mean, excuse me.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语；deal此处非交易。
chunks.quote: Folks, the Affordable Care Act—the old "Obamacare"—is still a very big deal.

chunks.chunk: I'm not going to let that happen
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 坚定阻止；that须有前文。
chunks.quote: The President. I'm not going to let that happen.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: But I'm not waiting. I want to provide an annual tax credit that will give Americans $400 a month for the next 2 years as mortgage rates come down to put toward their mortgages when they buy their first home or trade up for a little more space. Just for 2 years.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I want to provide an annual tax credit that will give Americans $400 a month for the next 2 years as mortgage rates come down to put toward their mortgages when they buy their first home or trade up for a little more space.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: When you refinance your home, you can save $1,000 or more as a consequence.

chunks.meaning: 严厉打击／整治某种行为
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: For millions of renters, we're cracking down on big landlords who use antitrust law—using antitrust—who break antitrust laws—by price-fixing and driving up rents. We've cut redtape so builders can get federally financing, which is already helping build a record 1.7 million new house—housing units nationwide.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原件redtape合写照录；正常教学核验red tape。
chunks.quote: We've cut redtape so builders can get federally financing, which is already helping build a record 1.7 million new house—housing units nationwide.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And I, like I suspect all of you, want to give a child—every child a good start by providing access to preschool for 3- and 4-years-old.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: You know, I think I pointed out last year—[applause]. I think I pointed out last year that children coming from broken homes where there's no books, they're not read to, not spoken to very often start school—kindergarten or first grade hearing—having heard a million fewer words spoken.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 不同于继续做同一件事。
chunks.quote: Well, studies show that children who go to preschool are nearly 50-percent more likely to finish high school and go on to earn a 2- and 4-year degree no matter what their background is.

chunks.chunk: Don't hold me to the exact number
chunks.meaning: 别要求我对这个确切数字打包票
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 说明数字为记忆中的估计。
chunks.quote: I pointed out to them: As Vice President, I met with over eight—I think it was 182 of those folks—don't hold me to the exact number—and I asked them what they need most—the CEOs.

chunks.chunk: on both sides of the aisle
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原指议会两党，职场使用需语境明确。
chunks.quote: And you've had the same experience on both sides of the aisle.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I want to expand high-quality tutoring and summer learning to see that every child learns to read by third grade. I'm also connecting local businesses and high schools so students get hands- on experience and a path to a good-paying job whether or not they go to college.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I'm also connecting local businesses and high schools so students get hands- on experience and a path to a good-paying job whether or not they go to college.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: When I was told I couldn't universally just change the way in which we did—dealt with student loans, I fixed two student loan programs that already existed to reduce the burden of student debt for nearly 4 million Americans, including nurses, firefighters, and others in public service.

chunks.meaning: 既然已经在做这事，就顺便……
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 引入相关追加事项。
chunks.quote: And while we're at it, I want to give public school teachers a raise.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And while we're at it, I want to give public school teachers a raise. And by the way, the first couple of years, we cut the deficit.

chunks.chunk: speak to the question of sth.
chunks.note: 正式；speak to非对物说话。
chunks.quote: Now let me speak to the question of fundamental fairness for all Americans.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原句为纳税，也可用于共同费用。
chunks.quote: Just pay your fair share in taxes.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语引入要点，非总指交易。
chunks.quote: But here's the deal.

chunks.meaning: 看看数据／把数核对一下
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 用证据核实判断的指令。
chunks.quote: They added more to the national debt than any Presidential term in American history. Check the numbers.

chunks.chunk: fight like hell to do sth.
chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语强烈，hell不宜正式温和沟通。
chunks.quote: The President. I sure don't. I'm going to keep fighting like hell to make it fair. Under my plan, nobody earning less than $400,000 a year will pay an additional penny in Federal taxes— nobody—not one penny. And they haven't yet.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: In fact, the child tax credit I passed during the pandemic cut taxes for millions of working families and cut child poverty in half. Restore that child tax credit. No child should go hungry in this country.

chunks.chunk: No one should have to choose between A and B
chunks.meaning: 不该让任何人被迫在A与B之间选择
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 规范立场，比don't have to更强调不应制造困境。
chunks.quote: Imagine a future with paid leave, because no one should have to choose between working and taking care of their sick family member.

chunks.meaning: 面临被削减／取消的危险
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 比喻；原文为社保。
chunks.quote: Many of my friends on the other side of the aisle want to put Social Security on the chopping block.

chunks.chunk: I kind of thought 从句
chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语缓和断言，也可含讽刺。
chunks.quote: The President. I kind of thought that's what your plan was.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 接收消息的回应；原场景含调侃。
chunks.quote: [Laughter] Well, that's good to hear.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 负面评价，勿用于中性利润增长。
chunks.quote: The President. ——too many corporations raise prices to pad their profits, charging more and more for less and less. That's why we're cracking down on corporations that engage in price gouging and deceptive pricing, from food to health care to housing.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语粗俗加强语。
chunks.quote: In fact, the snack companies think you won't notice if they change the size of the bag and put a hell of a lot fewer—[laughter]—same size bag—put fewer chips in it.

chunks.meaning: 在某人不知情的情况下
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Look, I'm also getting rid of junk fees, those hidden fees at the end of your bill that are there without your knowledge.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 本句事先告知总价，非预付义。
chunks.quote: I'm not stopping there. My administration has proposed rules to make cable, travel, utilities, and online ticket sellers tell you the total price up front so there are no surprises. It matters. It matters.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 承接已有举措再追加。
chunks.quote: I'm not stopping there.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语惊讶，darn为缓和damn；此处讽刺。
chunks.quote: Oh, you don't like that bill—huh?—that conservatives got together and said was a good bill? I'll be darned.

chunks.meaning: 如果有机会／在得到机会的条件下
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I believe that given the opportunity—for—a majority in the House and Senate would endorse the bill as well—a majority right now.

chunks.chunk: My heart goes out to sb.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 慰问悲痛者，不当普通轻微不便套语。
chunks.quote: To her parents, I say: My heart goes out to you.

chunks.chunk: It's highly unlikely that 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 限定可能性判断。
chunks.quote: But—but—if it's only 6 months—6 weeks, the idea is it's highly unlikely that people will pay that money and come all that way knowing that they'll be—able to be kicked out quickly.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 礼貌提出意见；原句含口语重启，不能整句当模板。
chunks.quote: Folks, I would respectfully suggest to my friend in—my Republican friends owe it to the American people.

chunks.meaning: 向某人施压要求其做某事
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: The President. And if my predecessor is watching: Instead of paying [playing; White House correction] politics and pressuring Members of Congress to block the bill, join me in telling the Congress to pass it. We can do it together. But that's what he apparently—here's what he will not do.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Unlike my predecessor, on my first day in office, I introduced a comprehensive bill to fix our immigration system. Take a look at it.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 本句用争论与行动作选择，属于论述表达结构而非习语。
chunks.quote: Look, folks, we have a simple choice: We can fight about fixing the border, or we can fix it.

chunks.meaning: 以为某人已死而将其丢下
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 叙事固定说法，含暴力语境。
chunks.quote: They were beaten. They were bloodied and left for dead. Our late friend and former colleague John Lewis was on that march. We miss him.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: But if you truly want to honor him and all the heroes who marched with him, then it's time to do more than talk.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语保证支持。
chunks.quote: And my message to transgender Americans is, I have your back.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 对先前判断添加保留。
chunks.quote: I don't think any of you think there's no longer a climate crisis. At least, I hope you don't.

chunks.note: 正式。
chunks.quote: And patterned after the Peace Corps and AmericaCorps [AmeriCorps; White House correction], I launched the Climate Corps to put 20,000 young people to work in the forefront of our clean energy future.

chunks.meaning: 让某事留在个人记录上
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原指犯罪记录，工作语境也须说明记录类型。
chunks.quote: Directing my Cabinet to review the Federal classification of marijuana and expunging thousands of convictions for the mere possession, because no one should be jailed for simply using or have it on their record.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Take on crimes of domestic violence. I'm ramping up the Federal enforcement of the Violence Against Women Act that I proudly wrote when I was a Senator so we can finally— finally end the scourge against women in America.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 比喻，不只军事冲锋。
chunks.quote: Well, I did do something by establishing the first ever Office of Gun Violence Prevention in the White House, that the Vice President is leading the charge. Thank you for doing it.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 引述对手冷漠措辞，悲伤场景可能非常冒犯；非推荐慰问。
chunks.quote: After another shooting in Iowa recently, he said—when asked what to do about it, he said, just "get over it." That was his quote.

chunks.chunk: We will not rest until 从句
chunks.meaning: 在……之前我们决不停止努力
chunks.note: 强烈承诺，演讲语域。
chunks.quote: I pledge to all the families that we will not rest until we bring every one of your loved ones home.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: We also—we will also work around the clock to bring home Evan and Paul, Americans being unjustly detained by the Russians—and others around the world.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 战争语域。
chunks.quote: Israel has a right to go after Hamas. Hamas ended this conflict by releasing the hostages, laying down arms—could end it by releasing the hostages, laying down arms, and surrendering those responsible for October 7.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Israel also has a fundamental responsibility, though, to protect innocent civilians in Gaza. This war has taken a greater toll on innocent civilians than all previous wars in Gaza combined. More than 30,000 Palestinians have been killed——

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 强势质疑来源；来自听众，不是总统。
chunks.quote: Audience member. Says who?

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原句自我重启保留，不将口误教学。
chunks.quote: I've been working nonstop to establish an immediate cease-fire that would last for 6 weeks to get all the prisoners released—all the hostages released and to get the hostages home and ease the intolerable and—humanitarian crisis and build toward an enduring—a more—something more enduring.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And Israel must do its part. Israel must allow more aid into Gaza and ensure humanitarian workers aren't caught in the crossfire. And they're announcing they're going to—they're going to have a crossing in Northern Gaza.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原文实际交火；也可比喻争端波及。
chunks.quote: And Israel must do its part. Israel must allow more aid into Gaza and ensure humanitarian workers aren't caught in the crossfire. And they're announcing they're going to—they're going to have a crossing in Northern Gaza.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 此处反对把援助作为筹码。
chunks.quote: To the leadership of Israel, I say this: Humanitarian assistance cannot be a secondary consideration or a bargaining chip.

chunks.meaning: 以某事终身支持者的身份
chunks.note: 正式立场身份；泛化程度待教学审校。lifelong为本句修饰语，不是固定形式。
chunks.quote: And I say this as a lifelong supporter of Israel, my entire career.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: As Commander in Chief, I will not hesitate to direct further measures to protect our people and our military personnel.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: For years, I've heard many of my Republican and Democratic friends say that China is on the rise and America is falling behind.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: For years, I've heard many of my Republican and Democratic friends say that China is on the rise and America is falling behind. They've got it backwards. I've been saying it for over 4 years, even when I wasn't President.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语纠正解释。
chunks.quote: For years, I've heard many of my Republican and Democratic friends say that China is on the rise and America is falling behind. They've got it backwards. I've been saying it for over 4 years, even when I wasn't President.

chunks.chunk: It never occurred to sb. to do sth.
chunks.meaning: 某人从没想到过要做某事
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: quote跨P241–242，否定思路曾出现，不一定指没能力。
chunks.quote: Frankly, for all his tough talk on China, it never occurred to my predecessor to do any of that.

chunks.meaning: 就这方面而言也一样／说起来
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 追加相近判断；原句重启较多。
chunks.quote: conflict [competition; White House correction] of the 21st century against China than anyone else for that matter—than at any time as well.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 多见于人员被派往危险任务。
chunks.quote: And keep our truly sacred obligation to train and equip those we send into harm's way and care for them and their families when they come home and when they don't.

chunks.meaning: 以我们目前所认识的形式
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 不是简单的正如我们所知。
chunks.quote: And we owe it to ourselves to keep supporting our new health research agency called ARPA–H—and remind us—to remind us that we can do big things, like end cancer as we know it.

chunks.chunk: owe it to sb. to do sth.
chunks.register: 中性／口语、工作；原素材为演讲
chunks.note: 第二遍补充：内部动词词块／义务整句表达。
chunks.quote: And we owe it to ourselves to keep supporting our new health research agency called ARPA–H—and remind us—to remind us that we can do big things, like end cancer as we know it.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语自我调侃，非一直在附近。
chunks.quote: I know I may not look like it, but I've been around a while.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I know the American story. Again and again, I've seen the contest between competing forces in the battle for the soul of our Nation, between those who want to pull America back to the past and those who want to move America into the future.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Now, other people my age see it differently.

chunks.chunk: watch in horror as 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 叙事反应表达结构。
chunks.quote: I watched in horror as two of my heroes—like many of you did—Dr. King and Bobby Kennedy, were assassinated. And their legacies inspired me to pursue a career of service.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And I became a county councilman almost by accident.

chunks.chunk: have no intention of doing sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I got elected to the United States Senate when I had no intention of running, at age 29. Then Vice President to our first Black President. Now a President to the first woman Vice President. In my career, I've been told I was too young. [Laughter] By the way, they didn't let me on the Senate elevators for votes sometimes. They—not a joke. [Laughter]

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 重新界定讨论焦点。
chunks.quote: The President. My fellow Americans, the issue facing our Nation isn't how old we are, it's how old are our ideas.

chunks.chunk: I see a future where 从句
chunks.note: 正式愿景表达结构，非只指眼睛看见。
chunks.quote: Tonight you've heard mine. I see a future where [we're; White House correction] defending democracy, you don't diminish it.

chunks.meaning: 很高兴看到大家聚在一起
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 见面与团体开场；不是认定用户已掌握的基础问候。together是本次聚会情境修饰，不是固定必要部分。
chunks.quote: Thank you. Good to see this Cabinet and staff together here.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: For over 200 years, America has carried on the greatest experiment in self-government in the history of the world—and that's not hyperbole, that's a fact—where the people—the people—vote and choose their own leaders, and they do it peacefully; and where, in a democracy, the will of the people always prevails.

chunks.chunk: work with sb. to do sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And I assured him that I would direct my entire administration to work with his team to ensure a peaceful and orderly transition.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: She ran an inspiring campaign, and everyone got to see something that I learned early on to respect so much: her character. She has a backbone like a ramrod. She has great character, true character. She gave her whole heart and effort, and she and her entire team should be proud of the campaign they ran.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 话语套语；点明明摆着的事实，有时带强调或讽刺。
chunks.quote: I know, for some people, it's a time for victory, to state the obvious.

chunks.chunk: You can't do sth. only when 从句
chunks.meaning: 不能仅在某种条件满足时才做……
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 外层立场表达结构；不可因此前教材已出现而删去。
chunks.quote: I've said many times you can't love your country only when you win.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Something I hope we can do no matter who you voted for is see each other not as adversaries, but as fellow Americans, bring down the temperature.

chunks.chunk: see sb. not as A, but as B
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 重新界定看待对象的方式；不是任意名词串。
chunks.quote: Campaigns are contests of competing visions. The country chooses one or the other. And we accept the choice the country made. I've said many times you can't love your country only when you win. You can't love your neighbor only when you agree. Something I hope we can do no matter who you voted for is see each other not as adversaries, but as fellow Americans, bring down the temperature.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I also hope we can restore the respect for all our election workers, who busted their necks and took risks at the outset. We should thank them, thank them for staffing voting sites, counting the votes, protecting the very integrity of the election. Many of them are volunteers who do it simply out of love for their country.

chunks.note: 较正式的时间套语。
chunks.quote: I also hope we can restore the respect for all our election workers, who busted their necks and took risks at the outset.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 动机结构，不是空间方向。
chunks.quote: Many of them are volunteers who do it simply out of love for their country.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And as they did their duty as citizens, I will do my duty as President. I will fulfill my oath, and I will honor the Constitution. On January 20, we'll have a peaceful transfer of power here in America.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语；此处幽默地称与自己共事。
chunks.quote: To all our incredible staff, supporters, Cabinet members, all the people who have been hanging out with me for the last 4 years—[laughter]—"God love you," as my mother would say—thank you so much.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: You put so much into the past 4 years.

chunks.meaning: 我听到了你的感受／我理解你
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 此处为认可痛苦；不自动表示同意对方观点。
chunks.quote: You're hurting. I hear you, and I see you.

chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 此处法律效果开始显现，口语。
chunks.quote: Much of the work we've done is already being felt by the American people. But the vast majority of it will not be felt—be felt over the next 10 years. We have a—we have legislation we passed that's just—only now just really kicking in.

chunks.chunk: It takes time to do sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: We're going to see over a trillion dollars' worth of infrastructure work done, changing people's lives in rural communities and communities that are in real difficulty, because it takes time to get it done, and so much more that's going to take time.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 限定判断成立的条件。
chunks.quote: The road ahead is clear, assuming we sustain it. There's so much—so much—we can get done and will get done based the way the legislation was passed. And it's truly historic.

chunks.meaning: 使某事向好的方向改变
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Together, we've changed America for the better.

chunks.chunk: get knocked down / get back up
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原文为比喻用法；也可字面指跌倒与起身。
chunks.quote: Look, folks, you all know it in your lives: Setbacks are unavoidable, but giving up is unforgivable. Setbacks are unavoidable, but giving up is unforgivable. We all get knocked down, but the measure of our character, as my dad would say, is how quickly we get back up.

chunks.chunk: the measure of sth. is how 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 评判标准表达结构，原句含插入语。
chunks.quote: We all get knocked down, but the measure of our character, as my dad would say, is how quickly we get back up.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 区分一次结果与持续状态；结构候选，非整句政治口号。
chunks.quote: Remember, a defeat does not mean we are defeated.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 放在数字后说明仍在累积。
chunks.quote: That's the story of America for over 240 years and counting.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: The American experiment endures, and we're going to be okay, but we need to stay engaged.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: And above all, we need to keep the faith.

chunks.register: 中性／口语、工作；原素材为演讲
chunks.note: 第二遍补充：内部动词词块／义务整句表达。
chunks.quote: We need to keep going.

chunks.meaning: 我是认真的／我是真心这么说的
chunks.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
chunks.note: 口语确认真诚。
chunks.quote: I'm so proud to have worked with all of you. I really mean it.

chunks.chunk: lay out sth. in great detail
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: After 8 months of nonstop negotiation, my administration—by my administration, a cease-fire and a hostage deal has been reached by Israel and Hamas, the elements of which I laid out in great detail in May of this year.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: That's why I told my team to keep the incoming administration fully informed, because that's how it should be: working together as Americans.

chunks.chunk: I've been thinking a lot about sth.
chunks.meaning: 我最近一直在认真考虑某事
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 现在完成进行时组织近期思考的说明。
chunks.quote: And I've been thinking a lot about who we are and, maybe more importantly, who we should be.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Long ago, in New York Harbor, an ironworker installed beam after beam, day after day.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: She was built to sway back and forth to withstand the fury of stormy weather, to stand the test of time, because storms are always coming.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 此处实体摇摆，不是观点反复。 同形变体保留：本句实物来回摇摆，另一条是政治争论的反复。
chunks.quote: She was built to sway back and forth to withstand the fury of stormy weather, to stand the test of time, because storms are always coming.

chunks.chunk: through good times and tough times
chunks.meaning: 无论顺境还是艰难时期
chunks.note: 开放搭配框架；演讲强调持续性。
chunks.quote: And yet, through good times and tough times, we've withstood it all.

chunks.meaning: 顶住、反抗某人或某种压力
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 与stand up for维护对象不同。
chunks.quote: Ongoing debates about power and the exercise of power, about whether we lead by the example of our power or the power of our example, whether we show the courage to stand up to the abuse of power or we yield to it.

chunks.chunk: It may not be perfect, but 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 承认限制后保留主要评价。
chunks.quote: Our system of separation of powers, checks and balances, it may not be perfect, but it's maintained our democracy for nearly 250 years, longer than any other nation in history that's ever tried such a bold experiment.

chunks.chunk: It's been the honor of my life to do sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 郑重感谢；日常可缩小程度，不能把全部当高频寒暄。
chunks.quote: It's been the honor of my life to see the resilience of essential workers getting us through a once-in-a-century pandemic, the heroism of servicemembers and first responders keeping us safe, the determination of advocates standing up for our rights and our freedoms.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 本句a 50-year low；常用数据说明搭配。原文50-year low，指具体时间范围的最低水平。
chunks.quote: And finally doing something to protect our children and our families by passing the most significant gun safety law in 30 years and bringing violent crime to a 50-year low.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 此处为有毒物质，不是公开披露。
chunks.quote: Meeting our sacred obligation to over 1 million veterans so far who were exposed to toxic materials and to their families—providing medical care and education benefits and more for their families.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 未来持续时间；不是过去几十年。
chunks.quote: But the seeds are planted, and they'll grow, and they'll bloom for decades to come.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 竞争中的位置变化。
chunks.quote: And overseas, we've strengthened NATO. Ukraine is still free. And we've pulled ahead of our competition with China. And so much more.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: I'm so proud of how much we've accomplished together for the American people. And I wish the incoming administration success, because I want America to succeed.

chunks.chunk: I have no doubt that 从句
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 表达确信，不是弱推测。
chunks.quote: That's why I've upheld my duty to ensure a peaceful and orderly transition of power to ensure we lead by the power of our example. I have no doubt that America is in a position to continue to succeed.

chunks.chunk: be in a position to do sth.
chunks.meaning: 处于有条件做某事的位置
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: That's why I've upheld my duty to ensure a peaceful and orderly transition of power to ensure we lead by the power of our example. I have no doubt that America is in a position to continue to succeed.

chunks.meaning: 任由某事发展而不加约束
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 通常用于令人担忧的趋势。
chunks.quote: And this is the dangerous concern—and that's the dangerous concentration of power in the hands of very few ultrawealthy people, and the dangerous consequences if their abuse of power is left unchecked.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Today, an oligarchy is taking shape in America of extreme wealth, power, and influence that literally threatens our entire democracy, our basic rights and freedoms, and a fair shot for everyone to get ahead.

chunks.chunk: have a fair shot at sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原文fair shot后接for everyone；表达结构为可迁移候选。
chunks.quote: Today, an oligarchy is taking shape in America of extreme wealth, power, and influence that literally threatens our entire democracy, our basic rights and freedoms, and a fair shot for everyone to get ahead.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Today, an oligarchy is taking shape in America of extreme wealth, power, and influence that literally threatens our entire democracy, our basic rights and freedoms, and a fair shot for everyone to get ahead.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原文口误pay the by—play保留，不收口误为模板。
chunks.quote: They just made the wealthy pay the by—play by the rules everybody else had to.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Workers won rights to earn their fair share.

chunks.meaning: 处于利害攸关之中；可能失去
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: So much is at stake. Right now the existential threat of climate change has never been clearer. Just look across the country, from California to North Carolina.

chunks.chunk: We don't have to choose between A and B
chunks.meaning: 我们不必在A与B之间二选一
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 澄清两者并非不可兼得。
chunks.quote: You know, we've proven we don't have to choose between protecting the environment and growing the economy.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: We must not be bullied into sacrificing the future, the future of our children and our grandchildren.

chunks.chunk: There is no time to waste
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 催促行动的套语。
chunks.quote: We must keep pushing forward and push faster. There is no time to waste.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: You know, his farewell address, President Eisenhower spoke of the dangers of the military- industrial complex. He warned us then about, and I quote, "the potential for the disastrous rise of misplaced power," end of quote. Six days—six decades later, I'm equally concerned about the potential rise of a tech-industrial complex that could pose real dangers for our country as well.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Americans are being buried under an avalanche of misinformation and disinformation enabling the abuse of power. The free press is crumbling. Editors are disappearing. Social media is giving up on fact-checking. The truth is smothered by lies told for power and for profit.

chunks.meaning: 要求某人为其行为负责
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: We must hold the social platforms accountable to protect our children, our families, and our very democracy from the abuse of power.

chunks.chunk: of our time / of all time
chunks.meaning: 我们这个时代的／有史以来的
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 比较时间范围不同。
chunks.quote: Meanwhile, artificial intelligence is the most consequential technology of our time, perhaps of all time. Nothing offers more profound possibilities and risks for our economy and our security, our society, it's our very—for humanity.

chunks.chunk: have the potential to do sth.
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Artificial intelligence even has the potential to help us answer my call to end cancer as we know it. But unless safeguards are in place, AI could spawn new threats to our rights, our way of life, to our privacy, how we work, and how we protect our Nation.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Artificial intelligence even has the potential to help us answer my call to end cancer as we know it. But unless safeguards are in place, AI could spawn new threats to our rights, our way of life, to our privacy, how we work, and how we protect our Nation.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: We need to ban Members of Congress from trading stock while they're in the Congress.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 本句为犯罪法律责任；非医学免疫。
chunks.quote: We need to amend the Constitution to make clear that no President—no President—is immune from crimes that he or she commits while in office. The President's power is not limited—it's not absolute, and it shouldn't be.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 原句people don't feel like they have，非feel like doing想做。
chunks.quote: Participating in our democracy becomes exhausting and even disillusioning, and people don't feel like they have a fair shot.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: A fair shot is what makes America, America. Everyone is entitled to a fair shot—not a guarantee, but just a fair shot, an even playing field—going as far as your hard work and talent can take you. We can never lose that essential truth—remain who we are.

chunks.note: 常见level playing field的本句变体；待跨语料核验后正式教学。
chunks.quote: Everyone is entitled to a fair shot—not a guarantee, but just a fair shot, an even playing field—going as far as your hard work and talent can take you.

chunks.meaning: 从普通／并不优越的起点出发
chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 叙事，不等于贫困。
chunks.quote: Only in America do we believe anything is possible, like a kid with a stutter from modest beginnings in Scranton, Pennsylvania, and Claymont, Delaware, sitting behind the—this desk in the Oval Office as President of the United States.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
chunks.quote: Upstairs in the Residence of the White House, I've walked by a painting of the Statue of Liberty I don't know how many times. In the painting, there are several workers climbing on the outstretched arm of the statue that holds the torch. It reminds me every day I pass it of the story and soul of our Nation and the power of the American people.

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 不同于known for因某特点出名。
chunks.quote: There's a story of a veteran—this is—a veteran, a son of an immigrant, whose job it was to climb that torch and polish the amber panes so rays of light could reach out as far as possible. He was known as the "keeper of the flame."

chunks.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
chunks.note: 可用于接近目标的评价。
chunks.quote: But what I believe is the America of our dreams is always closer than we think.

chunks.chunk: Let me close by doing sth.
chunks.note: 正式讲话结束语。
